# Codebase Guide

This document acts as a developer map for the EX-aero repository, describing the directory layout, namespaces, key source modules, and internal physical separation of concerns.

---

## 1. Directory Layout

The codebase is structured to isolate compile-time headers from high-performance GPU solvers and third-party dependencies:

```text
Ex-Aero/
├── CMakeLists.txt                  # Top-level C++20 build system
├── README.md                       # High-level overview and build instructions
├── zensical.toml                   # Central configuration for Zensical SSG
├── docs/                           # Documentation suites
│   ├── index.md                    # Documentation home page
│   ├── api-contracts.md            # Public APIs, C/Fortran bindings, index codes
│   ├── codebase-guide.md           # This guide
│   ├── conventions.md              # Coding standards and hygiene rules
│   ├── ci-cd.md                    # Build options and configuration reference
│   ├── architecture/               # Conceptual explanations and system overviews
│   ├── guides/                     # Step-by-step tutorials (Getting Started)
│   ├── specs/                      # Technical design specifications (GOCART, etc.)
│   ├── adr/                        # Architectural Decision Records (ADRs)
│   ├── plans/                      # Strategic execution/implementation plans
│   └── archive/                    # Archived documents
├── src/                            # Source tree
│   ├── CMakeLists.txt              # Build system for library targets
│   ├── exaero/                     # PUBLIC API BOUNDARY (Zero Kokkos dependency)
│   │   ├── IAerosolPackage.hpp     # Abstract package class and View declarations
│   │   ├── IAerosolPackage_C.h     # C-linkage wrappers for Fortran binding
│   │   ├── exaero_interface.f90    # ISO_C_BINDINGS Fortran adapter module
│   │   ├── AerosolIndices.hpp      # Output diagnostics and optics index codes
│   │   ├── Environment.hpp         # Public environment lifecycle helpers
│   │   └── MemoryMapper.hpp        # mdspan-to-Kokkos mapping templates
│   └── src_impl/                   # PRIVATE IMPLEMENTATIONS (Internal only)
│       ├── CMakeLists.txt          # Targets for bridge and GPU solvers
│       ├── gocart/                 # GOCART bulk aerosol proof-of-concept
│       │   ├── GocartPackage.hpp   # YAML reader and raw pointer adapter
│       │   ├── GocartPackage.cpp   # Bridging logic
│       │   ├── GocartSolver.cpp    # Parallel Kokkos kernels running on GPU
│       │   └── GocartSpeciesParams.hpp # Species-specific parameter structures
│       └── third_party/            # Privately vendored header dependencies
│           └── mdspan/             # Isolated single-header C++20 mdspan backport
└── tests/                          # Automated verification suites
    ├── CMakeLists.txt              # Unit test runner compilation instructions
    ├── test_main.cpp               # Standard physical & optical unit tests
    ├── test_memory_mapper.cpp      # Zero-copy mapping test suite
    ├── test_fuzzer.cpp             # Property-based invariants and crash fuzzer
    └── test_fortran_interface.f90  # Fortran interface verification runner
```

---

## 2. Key Namespaces

*   `exaero::`: Contains all public abstract classes, core structures, adapters, and environment helpers.
*   `exaero::diagnostic_indices::`: Diagnostic index codes (MASS, PM2.5, PM10, etc.) used to write to multidimensional diagnostics buffers.
*   `exaero::optical_indices::`: Optical index codes (extinction coefficient, scattering, AOT, etc.) used to write to multi-band optical property buffers.
*   `exaero_mdspan::`: The custom, isolated namespace under which the privately vendored C++20 `std::experimental::mdspan` backport is compiled, preventing collisions with system-wide Kokkos mdspan types.

---

## 3. Core Architectural Modules

### A. Memory Interface Boundary
The library bridges languages via raw pointer mapping:
1.  **C-bindings (`IAerosolPackage_C.cpp`):** Receives raw 1D pointers representing multidimensional matrices from Fortran.
2.  **Public Adapter Layer:** Wraps these pointers into dynamic, column-major (`layout_left`) standard `exaero_mdspan::mdspan` structures (such as `View2D`, `View3D`, `View4D`).
3.  **Memory Mapper (`MemoryMapper.hpp`):** Wraps raw data handles inside the `mdspan` boundary into unmanaged `Kokkos::View` structures on the Default Execution Space.

### B. Solvers (`GocartSolver.cpp`)
All GPU parallel kernels are housed under `src/src_impl/gocart/GocartSolver.cpp` and compiled using specialized GPU compilers. They define:
*   $\kappa$-Kohler sizing and wet-to-dry density parallel iterations.
*   Anomalous Diffraction Theory (ADT) analytical Mie scattering evaluations.
*   RH Lookup Table 1D linear interpolation.
*   Cloud droplet CCN activation thresholds over supersaturation bands.
*   Column-integrated vertical accumulation algorithms.
